title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30
source: SBD > ? > DAT > CD; CD > Sound Forge 10 > flac; Upgrade to existing source SBD 19903

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a solid 1973 show, highlighted by an excellent Eyes > Stella jam and a rare one‑drummer Black Peter.
ai_review.review: The recording is clean, well‑balanced and offers good stereo imaging with warm instrument presence, though there’s a brief dropout at the end of Dark Star. Musically the performance delivers steady energy, featuring a flowing Eyes > Stella sequence and the unusual one‑drummer Black Peter, while other staples like Bird Song and Playin’ are competent but not extraordinary.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently praise a clear soundboard recording and solid musical performance with notable highlights, offset by minor technical dropout and lack of spectacular moments, yielding an overall strong but not elite rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and clean soundboard tape with good stereo image and instrument presence; Phil's bass described as warm. Minor dropout at the end of Dark Star noted but not disruptive.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set 1 builds nicely with the extended Eyes > Stella jam in the middle and a rare one‑drummer Black Peter, keeping momentum steady throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass is described as warm and nice throughout the performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: Features a rare one‑drummer Black Peter segment, showcasing tight drumming.
